claim: By default a user pool refresh token expires 30 days after the user signs in; for each app client you can set the refresh token expiration to any value between 60 minutes and 10 years.
question: What is the default lifetime of an Amazon Cognito refresh token, and what range can you set?

evidence.quote: By default, the refresh token expires 30 days after your application user signs into your user pool. When you create an application for your user pool, you can set the application's refresh token expiration to any value between 60 minutes and 10 years.

note: d033 default. The quotas page says 1 hour to 3,650 days (same range).

claim: With refresh token rotation on, every token refresh returns a new ID, access and refresh token and invalidates the original refresh token; the new refresh token is valid only for the remaining time of the original, and the original can keep a grace period of up to 60 seconds.
question: What changes when you turn on Amazon Cognito refresh token rotation?

values.display: valid for the remaining duration of the original refresh token

evidence.quote: With refresh token rotation, your client can invalidate the original refresh token and issue a new refresh token with each token refresh. When this setting is enabled, each successful request in all forms of token refresh return a new ID, access, *and* refresh token. When this setting is disabled, token-refresh requests return new access and ID tokens only and the original refresh token remains valid. The new refresh token is valid for the remaining duration of the original refresh token.
To allow for retries for a brief duration, you can also configure a grace period for the original refresh token of up to 60 seconds.

claim: Refresh token rotation is not compatible with the REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH flow: app clients with rotation use the GetTokensFromRefreshToken operation or the token endpoint.
question: Can you use REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH with Amazon Cognito refresh token rotation?

values.display: isn't available in app clients with refresh token rotation enabled

evidence.quote: `REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH` isn't available in app clients with refresh token rotation enabled.
